summary: Baileys fork with weak static pattern match; no traced installer harm
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A a static rule matched on the co-occurrence of the tokens 'ping' and 'GET' inside lib/Utils/generics.js, which is the shape of ordinary HTTP/keepalive utility code in a networking library. No specific installer-side data read (env vars, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles, shell history) paired with a non-first-party destination was identified, no install-time lifecycle exfiltration was observed, and no dropper, silent-relay, credential-harvest, or backdoor fingerprint is present in the cited evidence. As a fork of a widely used library, however, the package should be treated as unverified relative to upstream.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
